verdict.rationale: Eqvista documents a centralized cap table that replaces spreadsheets and manages ownership, transactions, documents and stakeholder access in one place. It covers preferred share issuance, authorized shares, SAFEs added directly to the cap table, vesting and ESOP management, reports, a timeline and permissioned stakeholder access. ASC 718 reporting and a data room support investor and auditor use, and a community user confirms equity transactions update in real time. Missing for 10: any evidence of share certificate issuance or tracking, explicit documentation of individual option grant issuance beyond ESOP and vesting mentions, and independent corroboration that investors or auditors rely on it as the system of record.
